rule: Three registered rules, same entry and exit. R1: graduated 10-60 min after launch AND launched 7 AM-4:59 PM LA. R2 (slow burner): reached $100k more than 24 h after graduating. R3 (dormant breakout): a token that already crossed $100k sat 24 h+ below 30 % of its high, then jumped 3x within 10 minutes. Entry = $100 buy 60 s after the alert; exit = 3x or 72 h.
history: R1 backfill (157 tokens): $128 per $100 vs $102 for everything else; interim readout at 120 alerts / Sep 30, final at 240 / Oct 31. R2 was registered on Sep 13 with its threshold chosen from backfill data, so its backfill numbers count as ZERO evidence; only the live period tests it, closing at 100 crossings / Nov 30. R3 was registered on Sep 14 as the best of 8 backfill variants (19 trades, $137 per $100), so its backfill also counts as ZERO evidence; it fires about once a day and needs 60 trades (about two months). About 1 in 10 tokens hits 3x and 60 % lose more than half.
